string.text: Great. Going to need some money in advance though - {GOLD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON}. Can you pay?

One other small thing... I've had to take some money from some fairly dangerous people around here. I'll need {GOLD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} to get that beast off my back. Do you reckon you can pay me that?
I just went over the latest intelligence reports. Might I suggest a course of action?
Yes, m'{HONORIFIC}.
You know what, nevermind. You are doing great where you are.
I appreciate the thought, but I am happy where I am.
I will make sure to put in a request with the quartermaster unit right away.
I need to message some companions where they can find us.
Right, right, just fill out form 38-A and get it approved with your CO...
{PLAYER_NAME}, you have served already many years with honor and courage. No, we have something much better to offer you...
I must decline, m'{HONORIFIC}, I only wish to seek glory in battle, allow me to serve in your army once more.
If that is your wish. Serve with honor!
Can you help me with some equipment?
Excellent, you are dismissed.
What do you need, soldier?[ib:demure2][if:convo_bored]
I need some equipment issued to me.
Right away soldier! Just need to check the records...
Ok, says here, you can be issued {EQUIP_COUNT} set{EQUIP_PLURAL} of equipment for the {E_RANK} rank. Here's the catalogue...
Now let's see...
... just sign this and you are good to go. And make sure you return it or you will have to pay for it!
Ugh... sure, think about it some more...[if:convo_annoyed]
Wait... what?
Well... back to work![ib:confident2][if:convo_focused_happy]
I need to return some gear.
Nothing, just looking.
Yes m'{HONORIFIC}!
Whatever... I'm going back to work.
All right, let's check the old record book...
Ok, so which equipment are you returning. Make sure you have it here in your inventory.
I have this here...
I got nothing here for you. FFS, maybe you wanted equipment issued instead?
It looks like you don't have everything together yet. Come back later when you do.
All right, you're off the hook for that. Anything else?
I have more equipment?
I need something else.
What is it?
Let's get moving.
Hmm, seems you have already been issued equipment, look here...
Let me see...
Anything else?
I'm good for now.
Can I just pay for it?
Ok, sure, which set is that? Costs are listed.
This one...
Those are paid off now. Anything else?
That ain't going to cut it. Come back when you have the gold.[ib:closed2][if:convo_very_stern]
Hm. I need some time to think, if you don't mind.
I'll be back!
Yes, actually...
Move out!

Your service to the empire has not gone unnoticed. You certainly have made quite a name for yourself. I invite you to join our ranks as a {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?} and protector of the empire. Will you accept this duty?

Your service to the kingdom has not gone unnoticed. You certainly have made quite a name for yourself. I invite you to join our ranks as a {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?} and protector of the kingdom. Will you accept this duty?
Your service has not gone unnoticed. You have proven yourself over these past months. I would like to offer you the title of {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?} within our faction. What say you?
I am honored, m'{HONORIFIC}. I accept.
I must decline, m'{HONORIFIC}.
Excellent. Serve with honor!
I'm fucking this up, aren't I? Damnit! Give it to me straight {E_RANK}! What do we do?[ib:demure][if:convo_bored]
I see. Perhaps another time.
What is it soldier?
SIR! Awaiting orders! Sir!![ib:demure2]
I think I can be more helpful in another role.
I need to submit a unit transfer request.
When is my contract finished?
May I review my career statistics?
Nothing, Master Sergeant!
As you were, Master Sergeant!
Right away sir! Just need to submit Form 27B/6. Which unit are you requesting a transfer to?
I suggest we seek out the enemy. The reports suggest they could be around...

Oh really? I always assign people to their best suited roles based on their training evaluation scores!! You telling me my system don't work soldier!? FINE!! So what role would that be then... your highness?[if:convo_insulted][ib:hip2]
You'd be more useful keeping your big mouth shut {E_RANK}. I make those decisions here, not you! Get back to your unit![if:convo_aggressive][ib:aggressive2]
I'm just a stupid grunt sir, only good for killing.
Fine, we always have use for more grunts. Report to...
Uh, don't take this the wrong way, but I want your job.
WHAT?! First you blame my system, then you want to replace me. Fine, let's see you do better![if:convo_aggressive][ib:aggressive2]
I want a litte more adventure. Can I start going on recon missions?

Adventure huh? Not many come volunteering for recon. You better know what you're doing out there. Scouts go missing all the time on recon. Good luck kid! Go report to...[ib:confident3][if:convo_approving]
My skills can help keep the wounded alive.
Surgeon huh? Fiiiine, report to the surgeon tent. Dismissed!![ib:closed][if:convo_bored]
Oh, come now! The men love you sire. Uh, actually, the reports suggest our current course of action is just fine.
These hands were made to build siege engines.
Oh a smarty pants huh?! Let's see here... yes, yes... ok, we have a spot open. Report to...[ib:closed][if:convo_bored]
Actually, you were right from the start!
No shit, now get back to your unit! Dismissed!
I want to serve alongside my men. Put me with the grunts.
The men will be proud to serve alongside you, sir!
I'll be handling quartermaster duties now.
Right away sir! We keep our records here...
I'm transferring to the scouts unit.
Sir, you'll make a damn fine scout, sir!
Oh! But of course! You forget I am well versed in the arts of war![ib:confident][if:convo_relaxed_happy]
I am going to serve in the surgeons unit.
Sir, you are truly a hero, sir!
I think I will transfer to the engineers unit.
Sir, they will be lucky to have you, sir!
Actually, cancel that request, I will stay with my current unit!
Sir, excellent idea, sir!
You have {ENLISTMENT_DAYS_LEFT} days left!
I have it all written down here...
Anything else?
Good, get back to your duties!
My {HONORIFIC}, a report from the recon unit came in. We can cancel that patrol mission.
Soldier, your contract is up and your duty has been fulfilled. If you want to make a career out of this you should renew your contract for another year. What'll it be?
Sign me up for another year.
I think I will be retiring.
Excellent, just sign here...
That's a damn shame, you had talent kid. Well, sign here and you are free to go...
That's a damn shame, you had talent kid. Well, sign here and you are free to go, once we get to land of course, ha ha.[ib:confident][if:convo_merry]
That's a damn shame, you had talent kid. Well, sign here and you are free to go... oh and hold onto any equipment you got from the armorer in case you come back. You earned it kid!
Alright jabronis! Listen up! Welcome to your new family for the next year! There are rules here! Everybody fights, nobody quits! If you don't do your job, I'll kill you myself!!
Now listen up! When I call your name and role, step forward and report to your unit!
{E_RANK} {PLAYER_NAME}!! {E_ROLE} unit!!!!
Sir, yes, SIR!!!!!
Good! We'll do it my way now![ib:confident][if:convo_relaxed_happy]
... Pvt. Rico!!! Grunt Unit!!! ...
Uh... SIR!! I think I can be more helpful in another role! SIR!!!!!!
Holy mother of god?! WHO SAID THAT?!?![if:convo_aggressive][ib:aggressive2]
LOOKS LIKE WE HAVE A FREE THINKER!!! Apparently, this stupid looking son of a bitch thinks he is smarter than all of us!![if:convo_insulted][ib:hip2]
FINE YOUR HIGHNESS, HOW DARE I NOT CONSULT WITH YOU FIRST!!!! WHAT ROLE WOULD BEST SUIT HIS LORDSHIP?![if:convo_approving][ib:demure2]
SIR!!! I'm just a stupid grunt!! Only good for killing!!! SIR!!!!!!!!
THAT'S THE FIRST TIME YOU'VE BEEN RIGHT ALL DAY!! REPORT TO THE GRUNTS UNIT!!! NOW MOVE!!!![ib:aggressive2][if:convo_approving]
SIR!! Uh, I want to serve under you and be part of the quartermaster unit. SIR!!!!!!!
100 PUSHUPS!!!! NOW!!!!!! THEN REPORT TO THE QUARTERMASTER UNIT!!! FREE THINKERS IS JUST WHAT WE NEED!![if:convo_aggressive][ib:aggressive2]
SIR!!! I WANT TO SEARCH FOR THE ENEMY BEFORE THEY CAN HURT MY NEW FAMILY, SIR!!!
I would like to enlist in your party, m'{HONORIFIC}.
YOU STUPID SON OF A BITCH!!! THE ENEMY WILL FIND YOU FIRST AND YOU WILL DIE!! PROVE ME WRONG, SON!!!!!! REPORT TO THE SCOUTS UNIT!!![ib:convo_aggressive][if:aggressive2]
SIR, GOD GAVE ME A GIFT, AND IT WAS TO MEND THE WOUNDED, SIR!!!
AND NOW HE IS A PROPHET SENT BY THE BUTTERLORD HIMSELF TO HEAL US!!! FINE!!! REPORT TO THE SURGEON TENT!! MOVE!!! MOVE!!! MOVE!!![ib:convo_aggressive][if:aggressive2]
SIR!!! I AM A WIZ ON THE ABACUS!!! ALLOW ME TO BUILD YOUR SIEGE ENGINES... SIR!!!

WHY HOW DARE I NOT RECOGNIZE YOUR GENIUS?? WELL, HERE'S A NEW PROBLEM TO CALCULATE, WIZ!!! HOW LONG WILL IT TAKE YOU TO DO 100 PUSHUPS WHILE WE ALL WATCH?!?!! AND AFTER YOU MAY REPORT YOUR FINDINGS TO THE ENGINEER UNIT!!!! NOW DROP AND GIVE ME 100!!![ib:convo_aggressive][if:aggressive2]
Sir, uh, Actually, you were right from the start!
MOVE!!! MOVE!!!! MOVE!!!!! GET THE FUCK OUT OF HERE BEFORE I SHOVE MY BOOT UP YOUR ASS...[ib:convo_aggressive][if:aggressive2]
I can use someone like you in my company. You should think about enlisting with {E_COMMANDING_LORD}.
Right... {GOLD_AMOUNT} Here you are. You owe me drinks at the tavern for the next year lol.
Who the hell do you think I am... your parents?!
Is that so. Go speak with my quartermaster, then fall in line soldier.
Thinking again, I already have more companions than I can manage.
It's good to see you again. I am enlisted with {E_COMMANDING_LORD}, let's head back to camp soon.
It is good to see you too {E_RANK}, let's head out soon.[ib:demure2][if:convo_merry]
How are you doing with the {E_COMP_UNIT}s? I was thinking your talents would be better suited in another unit.
It's ok, I guess. What did you have in mind?[ib:demure2][if:convo_merry]
You are an amazing fighter, the Grunt unit could use you!
Your leadership skills are unmatched, the Quartermaster unit could use you!
You have a keen eye and know this land better than anyone, the Scout unit could use you!
You have a way of tending to the wounded and your knowledge of medicine is invaluable, the Surgeon unit could use you!
You are so talented with numbers, the Engineer unit could use you!
Just so you know... I'm not cheap. I want {GOLD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} as an advance, or there's no deal.[ib:warrior]

At attention, {HERO}! So you aren't dead yet, that means I have to promote you. You're getting a pay raise. Now don't go spending it all on the tavern. Ha, just kidding, that's what I do. Anyways, good work {E_RANK} and make sure to stop by the armorer for an upgrade! Now, as you were.
At attention, {HERO}! So you aren't dead yet, that means I have to promote you. You're getting a pay raise. Make sure to invest it on some better gear. Good work {E_RANK}! Now, as you were.
Sir, yes sir!
Very well. I'm going to need about {GOLD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} to settle up some debts, though. Can you pay?
There are some townspeople who've looked after me here, made sure I was fed and that. I'd like to give them something before I go. Could I ask for {GOLD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} as an advance?
Very well. But the world being as it is, I'm going to need {GOLD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} as a down payment on my services. Can you pay that?
So, uh, there's a young woman around here. I really need to leave her some money before I go anywhere. Let's say {GOLD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} - can you pay me that?
